payload.title: HTTP
payload.summary: Implement a bounded HTTP/1.1 message subset with borrowed spans, strict framing, and deadline-based stream I/O.

prerequisites: POSIX sockets and TCP byte streams
Protocol errors, system-call errors, and bounded buffers
outcomes: Construct a small HTTP/1.1 request without allocation
Parse requests and responses into non-owning spans
Separate HTTP message framing from TCP reads
Reject ambiguous framing and recognize premature EOF

payload.exercise: Implement deterministic request construction, strict Content-Length parsing, shared-deadline socket loops, and the fixed-response serve_one path in exercise.c.
payload.reference: Use solution.c only after preserving every initialized-output, limit, and framing rule in lesson.h.
checks: Exact request bytes and borrowed request/response views
Invalid arguments, small buffers, truncated bodies, and bounded limits
Rejection of transfer encoding, obsolete folding, and conflicting or invalid lengths
Fragmented localhost send/receive under one monotonic deadline
serve_one propagation of truncation, timeout, malformed input, and capacity failures

allowed: Caller-supplied storage and borrowed message views
excluded: External networking, raw capture, or privileged operations
Heap allocation or global mutable state
Production HTTP features such as TLS, chunking, proxies, compression, or pipelining
